errors.description: The pocket mouth / hem seam is rendered as a downward-pointing chevron (western-jeans style yoke across the top of the pocket) instead of the straight horizontal hem line drawn in the tech pack.
errors.expected: straight horizontal top edge with a straight horizontal hem stitch line about 20% down the pocket, per the illustration
errors.actual: top edge is straight but the hem seam angles down from both top corners to a V at the centre, adding a chevron that does not exist in the drawing

errors.description: The shot is a half-torso portrait rather than the required tight documentation crop; the model's chin, collar, both shoulders and a full sleeve are in frame.
errors.expected: chest pocket dominates 40-80% of the frame, framed tight on the left chest pocket
errors.actual: pocket occupies roughly 11% of the frame area

errors.description: The pocket side seams taper inward toward the point rather than running parallel; partly attributable to the body wrap/perspective but the outline is narrower at the base than drawn.
errors.expected: parallel vertical sides with squared top corners, narrowing only where the V begins
errors.actual: both sides converge gradually from the mouth downward, most visibly on the outboard (armhole) side
